why: A (proposition_8_1, universes at 0): every project τ : Φ → Ψ has Tτ : EpNatTrans Φ.tangent Ψ.tangent with Tτ.app = tangentMap τ, and Φ ≃ Ψ → TΦ ≃ TΨ. B: for τ satisfying B's reading of Definition 8.1.13 there are EpFunctors TΦ, TΨ : T(X,𝐗) → T(Y,𝐘) whose object/morphism maps are the tangent maps of Φ, Ψ, and the tangent map of τ satisfies B's natural-transformation conditions for them. A ⇒ B: package τ as a project EpNatTrans (ofB), apply A, take TΦ := Φ.tangent, TΨ := Ψ.tangent (obj/mor are the tangent maps by rfl) and read B's conditions off Tτ's fields (the two tangent maps of τ agree by proof irrelevance). B ⇒ A: B's TΦ, TΨ equal Φ.tangent, Ψ.tangent by EpFunctor.ext, so B's conditions build Tτ; the 'in particular' conjunct is the same construction on a witness. Same content; the only extra in A's second conjunct is an immediate corollary.
overlap: B_to_A: 653 shared project theorems, all reached through the definitions in the statements (EpGroupoid.tangentEpGroupoid._proof_1–4, EpFunctor.tangent._proof_1–6 and the Part I tangent-bundle/sc-calculus infrastructure under them) plus the EpNatTrans/EpFunctor field accessors; none of EpNatTrans.tangent's proof fields (the project's naturality computation for Tτ) is reached.
